annotations.text:
Admin Portal redesign

Direction 1 — a work queue above a browsable table.
Direction 2 — status shown as a 3-step track.
Plus the stat tiles and filter chips merged into one control.

Rows beyond the five fixture boards are sample data.
The current page, rebuilt from the real component values — six equal tiles, the same six statuses repeated as chips, and an Actions column that sets each row's height.
